# SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries

**子图搜索与查询参数**

式(57)/(58) 的显式实成本表达式、floor 参数选择的 polylog-free 算术界、note-added 参数替换与指数比较。

**边界**：仅成本表达式算术，不是算法或端到端查询复杂度证明；floor 与原文最近整数相差至多1，但不对等式或 polylog 省略作算法级桥接。未实现 edge oracle、诱导子图存储、walk、递归搜索、逐步查询计数、成功率或 bounded-error 保证。

**覆盖等级**：C+

| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.cliqueMem` | def | L40 | The natural-number floor of the memory scale `N ^ a`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.cliqueMem_le` | lemma | L44 | The rounded memory size is at most the real-valued scale `N ^ a`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.rpow_mem_ge_two` | lemma | L49 | For `N ≥ 4` and `a ≥ 1 / 2`, the real power `N ^ a` is at least two. |

| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.directMemory` | def | L72 | The memory choice obtained by rounding down `N ^ (L / (L + 1))`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.directCost` | def | L76 | The direct clique-finding cost expression `M ^ 2 + (N / M) ^ (L / 2) * M ^ (3 / 2)`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.directCost_le` | theorem | L81 | For `L ≥ 1` and `N ≥ 4`, bounds the direct cost by `(2 + 2 ^ (L / 2)) * N ^ (2L / (L + 1))` when `M` lies between half and all of the prescribed memory scale [ChildsEisenberg2003]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.direct_cost_bound` | theorem | L192 | For each `L ≥ 1`, the direct cost at `directMemory N L` is bounded by a positive constant times `N ^ (2L / (L + 1))` for every `N ≥ 4` [ChildsEisenberg2003]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.recursiveMemory` | def | L207 | The memory choice obtained by rounding down `N ^ (L / (L + 2))`. |

| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.recursiveCost_le` | theorem | L218 | For `L ≥ 2` and `N ≥ 4`, bounds the recursive cost by `(1 + 2 ^ ((L + 1) / 2)) * N ^ ((5L - 2) / (2L + 4))` under the stated bounds on `M` [ChildsEisenberg2003]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.recursive_cost_bound` | theorem | L399 | For each `L ≥ 2`, the recursive cost at `recursiveMemory N L` is bounded by a positive constant times `N ^ ((5L - 2) / (2L + 4))` for every `N ≥ 4` [ChildsEisenberg2003]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.noteAddedMemory` | def | L415 | The note-added memory choice obtained by rounding down `N ^ ((L - 1) / L)`. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.note_added_cost_bound` | theorem | L420 | For each `L ≥ 2`, the recursive cost at `noteAddedMemory N L` is bounded by a positive constant times `N ^ (2(L - 1) / L)` for every `N ≥ 4` [ChildsEisenberg2003]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.noteAdded_subsumes_direct` | theorem | L602 | For `L ≥ 1`, the note-added exponent `2(L - 1) / L` is no greater than the direct exponent `2L / (L + 1)` [ChildsEisenberg2003]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.table_one_comparisons` | theorem | L610 | The recursive exponent is smaller than the direct exponent for `L = 3, 4, 5`, while the direct exponent is smaller for `L = 6` [ChildsEisenberg2003]. |
| `Qatlib.Papers.SubsetFinding03.CliqueQueries.noteAdded_improves_recursive_at_five` | theorem | L619 | At `L = 5`, the note-added exponent is strictly smaller than the recursive exponent [ChildsEisenberg2003]. |
